subject: Post-discovery: inference constraints evaluation session — slot selection
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@tidewave.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling a constraints eval session

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — Alex from TideWave here. We came away with a pretty clear set of constraints we want to validate before committing to a Dedicated footprint: network egress patterns, KV-cache warmup impact on cold starts, and token throughput for our 4k average sequences.

Would Redwood be available for a focused technical session next week (60-90 minutes) to walk through the above and run a quick smoke test plan? Our goals:
- Confirm topology and NAT/firewall requirements for VPC-private deployments
- Check KV cache priming strategies and expected latency impact on first user hits
- Validate sustained token throughput with batching profile similar to our prod traces

We're in PDT (San Francisco) — available windows: Wed 8/12 after 1pm PDT, Thu 8/13 morning 9–11am PDT, or Fri 8/14 10–12pm PDT. If those don't work, happy to propose alternatives.

I attached the discovery notes and our infra inventory for context. Please loop in whoever from your infra/ops side should be on the call.

Best,
Alex Jenkins
Head of Platform Engineering
TideWave AI
Attachments: tidewave-discovery-notes.pdf, infra-inventory.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@tidewave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling a constraints eval session

Alex — great to hear and glad the discovery was productive. Thanks for sending the notes.

We can run the session and come prepared with:
- A short topology review (10–15m) covering VPC, NAT, and routing patterns we typically see
- KV cache primer + demo (20–25m) with expected latency delta for cold vs warmed prefixes
- Throughput test plan (20–30m) using a sampled batching profile based on your traces
- Ops Q&A and next steps (10–15m)

Proposed slots (all PDT):
A) Wed 8/12, 2:30–4:00pm
B) Thu 8/13, 9:00–10:30am
C) Fri 8/14, 10:30–12:00pm

Ben (infra) and Rishi (SRE) are copied — they will lead the KV-cache and throughput pieces. We have a draft agenda attached (constraints-eval-agenda.pdf) and a sample topology diagram (topology-sample.drawio) that I can update with your network CIDRs if you share them.

If you prefer a shorter 60-minute working session, we can compress the demo pieces and focus on highest-risk items. Also happy to run the throughput tests asynchronously if you prefer to avoid a long live run.

Let me know which slot you prefer and whether to include TideWave infra lead so we can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132
Attachments: constraints-eval-agenda.pdf, topology-sample.drawio

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@tidewave.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara.malik@tidewave.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling a constraints eval session

Hi Naomi — thanks, that agenda looks perfect. I invited our infra lead Sara (cc'd).

Slot B (Thu 8/13, 9:00–10:30am PDT) would have been ideal, but we have a conflict with a vendor sync. Could we move to Thu 8/13, 11:00–12:30pm PDT instead? That gives our infra lead time to join after their standup.

Also, quick ask: can Ben include any notes on outbound egress bandwidth for a 2x reserved Dedicated pool (estimate in MB/s per GPU)? If you have a rough table in the deck, that would help our CISO team review post-call.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling a constraints eval session

Perfect — Thu 8/13 11:00–12:30pm PDT is confirmed. I just sent a calendar invite (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456).

Notes / action items before the session:
- TideWave: can you share your primary egress NAT CIDR and a recent sample of token-length distribution (CSV) so we can preconfigure batching knobs? (Sara, tagging you on this)
- Redwood: Ben will prepare a short egress bandwidth table for a 2x reserved pool and attach it to the deck; Rishi will prepare the throughput test harness notes.
- Agenda and topology diagram attached. If you want us to run a short live throughput test, please confirm the test CIDR and an approval window (we will keep it isolated to avoid noise to your production infra).

Looking forward to it — we'll keep the session hands-on and action-oriented.

Best,
Naomi
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: constraints-eval-agenda.pdf, topology-sample.drawio, redwood-egress-estimates.xlsx
